main_text.p: Aft, cave credas Lector, sequentibus Corollariis stigma inuri Coccejo, atque etiam hunc minimè contemnendum Theologum à Magno hoc Censore in grege Weigelianorum annumerari. judicat enim fortè honorifice de Celeberrimo Coccejo his verbis, noftra verò hæc eft ftupiditas ut id non capiamus. III. Male, inquit, cùm idem Weigelius, tum alii, negarunt Patribus Veteris Teftamenti Spiritum Adoptionis, & Servitutis tantummodò illum adfcripferunt. Neque enim quicquam horum Coccejo fuit imputatum unquam fcilicet. Hæc certè fi infpiciantur penitius, & confideretur attentius quid mentita illa belgica (de nodige aentwijfinge &c.) quid in fuâ Mantiffa argumentatione vah quàm futili à Coccejo doctum fcriptumve fruftrà adftruere conatus fuerit Hulfius, Spanhemio profecto Frater tantùm non gemellus, nullo fermè labore & procul omni errandi periculo judicabit omnis, quo jure quâve injuria Spanhemius fe jactet nulli Collegarum injurium, fcriptis nullis contentiofum, nullo judicio exactorem rigidum, nulla Hæ-
Hulfius ... (transcribed as printed in the body; the Greek word in the text is rendered as printed: Ἀπόδειξις).

page.notes: The Greek word before "belgica" (Ἀπόδειξις, printed in a ligatured form) is uncertain and is transcribed approximately; the Dutch black-letter phrase is set in Fraktur within the roman text. The final line is a catchword "Hæ-". The footnote above is not a printed note and should be disregarded.
